answer: Each agent starts its voyage with a fresh, non-transferable work credential: it must complete a real task that independent checkers verify inside the epoch, and the credential then expires, like a pearl that cannot be hoarded, sold, or reused. A vine of trust grows only from such live credentials, never from copied history. An attacker must redo full verified work for every fake identity in every epoch, so a thousand Sybils cost a thousand fresh proofs, while one honest agent pays once.
